title: Kostka-Napierski uprising
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Kostka-Napierski uprising", at revision 1371450090, opens: "The Kostka Napierski uprising was a peasant revolt in Poland in 1651." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q6433559, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Polish peasant uprising". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
